name: Gan.AI
title: gan.ai
shortDescription: Gan.AI enables rapid creation of AI-generated videos tailored for businesses. Users can type a script, choose an avatar, and instantly produce videos with synchronized lip-sync and voice cloning. Ideal for marketing and customer engagement, it's used by Fortune 500 companies to create personalized video content at scale, such as the San Antonio Spurs for fan engagement.
pros: High customization of avatars and voices
cons: May require creative input for scripts
Dependent on AI accuracy for voice cloning
Potential privacy concerns with voice cloning
